description: electron-vite app with all THREE legs (main, preload, renderer) obfuscated by @afterpack/electron in one call. The point of the fixture is the cross-bundle seed contract: every leg of one build must obfuscate with ONE seed. No browser-served surface, so `smoke` is deliberately absent -- the obfuscated main + preload bundles are EXECUTED under node against a stub `electron` module (crossing the real ipcMain/ipcRenderer boundary) and the obfuscated renderer bundle is EXECUTED in headless Chromium over file://, which needs no display server.

build.note: obfuscation runs automatically via @afterpack/electron (electron.vite.config.ts) -- no separate step
